original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚工程监管委员会就两起建筑坍塌事件对两名工程师立案
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚工程监管委员会（COREN）表示，经调查贡贝州议会大厦雨棚坍塌和联邦首都区阿布贾一栋在建三层建筑坍塌事件后，已对两名工程师确立初步证据案件。COREN强调，确立初步证据案件不等于最终认定有罪或须承担责任，涉事工程师将有机会依法申辩。相关调查已提交COREN工程法庭进一步审理。该消息目前仅来自单一来源。

location.site: Plot No. 481, Cadastral Zone B13, Gaduwa District
location.raw_text: Gombe State House of Assembly Complex; Plot No. 481, Cadastral Zone B13, Gaduwa District, Abuja

key_facts.fact: COREN就两起建筑坍塌事件对两名工程师确立初步证据案件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) says it has established prima facie cases against two engineers following investigations into separate building collapse incidents in Gombe and Abuja.

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州议会大厦钢筋混凝土悬臂入口雨棚于2026年7月10日坍塌
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the first incident involved a reinforced concrete cantilever entrance canopy at the Gombe State House of Assembly Complex, which collapsed on July 10, 2026.

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾Gaduwa区一栋在建三层建筑于2026年5月16日坍塌
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The second incident involved a three-storey building under construction at Plot No. 481, Cadastral Zone B13, Gaduwa District, Abuja, which collapsed on May 16, 2026.

key_facts.fact: COREN称初步证据案件不等于最终认定有罪或须承担责任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the establishment of prima facie cases did not amount to a final determination of guilt or liability, adding that the affected engineers would have the opportunity to defend themselves in accordance with the law.

uncertainties: 涉事工程师的责任尚未最终认定，有待COREN工程法庭进一步审理
该报道目前仅来自单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏交叉验证
